excerpt.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
excerpt.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

texts.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

texts.zh:
这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。这只生物突然回过神来，挥动触角自我介绍道:

啊？怎么？这是哪？抱歉。我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，是布洛葛合众国的探险家和外交官。你听说过人类吗？
texts.en:
The repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Abruptly regaining composure, with a flourish of tentacles the creature introduces itself: 

What- Whe- Where am I? I am sorry. My name is Mercedes Romero, explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commmonality. Do you know of the Humans?

texts.zh:
这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。在注意到我们之后，她几乎要猛扑上来，然后又控制住了自己。

你们、你们是人类！？*尖叫*我——我太抱歉了，从我还是一只萌孢的时候就对你们的文化超级感兴趣！

这只外星人伸出了一只触手，令人尴尬地尝试模仿握手动作。

我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，很高兴见到你们。
texts.en:
The repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Upon registering us, it makes a lunging movement before restraining itself.

Y- You- You are Humans!? *Squeee* I- I am sorry, I have been fascinated with your culture ever since I was a little sporeling!

The alien extends a tentacle in an awkward attempt to mimic a handshake.

My name is Mercedes Romero and it is my pleasure to meet you.

label.zh: 你为什么对人类如此感兴趣？
label.en: Why are you so fascinated with Humans?
What can you do for us?
